Sarah — no problem, thanks for the note. Totally understandable.

Proposal:
- Split into two back-to-back 25m blocks to match your ask:
  * Block A (engineering deep-dive): routing, KV cache checks, and loadtest control — recommend 5 concurrent workers, 2s think-time (light), ~200 tokens/sample.
  * Block B (product demo & prompt review): walk prompts, go/ no-go criteria, failure cases and fallback routing.
- Suggested slots (PT): 
  * Wed 29 Sep: 11:30am–12:20pm (blocks at 11:30 and 11:55)
  * Thu 30 Sep: 3:00pm–3:50pm (blocks at 3:00 and 3:25)

Lauren, Dev — can you confirm you're available to run the engineering block for the two suggested windows?

If those don't work, we can also do asynchronous prep: we can record the short prompt run-through and hand over the runbook so your team can run the small-batch loadtest during a maintenance window; we'll review results the next day.

Thanks — Karthik

Hi Sarah —

I can take the engineering block. Quick notes on the technical run:
- We'll use a capped loadtest: 5 concurrent clients, ramp-up 30s, steady state 2 minutes, 2s think-time per call. That should be well under your internal limits.
- We'll disable long context caching, run a KV-clear between test phases, and monitor latency at token- and request-level.
- Please ensure the sandbox IAM token has at least 'invoke' permissions for model endpoints; if not, send me a short role ARN and I'll temporarily whitelist.

Attached a trimmed version of the runbook with the exact curl commands and the loadtest-template.yml.

If you'd prefer asymmetric timing (engineering first then product), that's fine — I recommend engineers go first to surface any infra issues.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — Wed 29 Sep at 11:30am PT works for our engineers; we'll stack the product block at 11:55am. Dev, we'll send the IAM role/ARN to you in a separate note by EOD.

Two quick asks before we start:
1) Can you limit the test payloads to anonymized samples — we can't use production PII.
2) If the loadtest shows any token-level spikes > 600ms on p50, please pause and flag us immediately; we have a change freeze at 12:00pm.

I'll confirm the attendee list (ops + two engineers) 30m before. Appreciate the flexibility and the runbook.

Best,
Sarah
Evaluation Lead, Acme Analytics
